title: Your practice project: build it, ship it, post it
purpose: The project you picked from your list, scoped to ship in days, on your map with its brief.
why: A small project that works, in public, with a README that says what it proves, is checkable proof for the job you want. Ship the smallest version first, in a few days.
evidence: A public repo with a README and a demo, and one post about it.

tasks.title: Build the first version, starting from the three steps in the brief
how: The brief above is yours to change. Cut anything that won't fit in the days it names.
Work in a public repo from the first commit, so the history shows how you think.
Stop when the smallest version works end to end. Polish comes after it's live.
tasks.done_when: The smallest version works end to end, in a public repo.

tasks.title: Ship it: a README that says what it proves, and a demo anyone can open
tasks.done_when: A stranger can open the link, see it work, and read in the README what problem it solves and what you decided.

fields.label: Link to the repo or the demo

tasks.title: Post about it: pick a draft written from your project and make it yours
tasks.done_when: The post is live and every claim in it is something you did.
